purpose: Decorative automotive campaign backgrounds inspired by the owner's App mobile banner reference. No new imagery claims to depict dealer premises or inventory.

prompts.home:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one finished ultrawide 3:1 raster background for an automotive website hero, approximately 2172x724.
Style: polished automotive campaign artwork, deep graphite black (#15181d) backdrop, delicate low-contrast silver halftone dots sweeping along the lower OUTER corners, one restrained thin red arc near an outer corner, realistic clean automotive product photography integrated into a designed graphic backdrop. Like premium car banner artwork on a black field. No invented dealership, buildings, rooms or scenic landscapes.
Layout requirements: center 68% of the canvas is calm EMPTY charcoal negative space from top to bottom; no cars, props, light streaks or high-contrast dots in the center. Website title will sit at x=50%, y=42%, and a wide white search/control panel across the central 68% at y=64-96%, so keep all recognisable subjects confined to far-left 16% and far-right 16%, outside that panel. Objects sit on the same low baseline at 83% canvas height. Top 25% is quiet black behind a white navigation overlay. The background tone, low floor reflection, image framing and pattern density must be consistent across this asset family. Subjects can be partly cropped by the outer frame; do not make them tiny floating thumbnails. A little natural colour in cars/props is welcome, black remains dominant.
Constraints: no people, no UI, no lettering, no readable manufacturer badges, no logos, no signage, no watermarks, no huge cartoon coins, no cartoon perspective, no architecture. This is decorative automotive campaign artwork and does not depict a real dealer's premises.
Primary request: a Home banner. Far left: cropped three-quarter nose and front wheel of a handsome pearl silver performance estate. Far right: cropped nose and front wheel of a graphite premium coupe. Beautiful studio lighting and accurate vehicle proportions, inward-facing composition. Very subtle red accent along an extreme edge.
